{{Top|leg}}
[[Dantooine Base (Imperial)|Dantooine Base]] was a presumably [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-owned outpost on the planet of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Anyone who held the ''[[Intergalactic Passport]]'' and were to travel through certain areas of the known galaxy that were directly controlled by the Galactic Emperor were required to register their location to the base's [[Unidentified commander (Dantooine Base)|commander]] before departure, as well as maintain regular contact with this base throughout the voyage using established communication codes, as not even the Imperial Senate could guarantee clearance through these areas.
